high_level_description: Bloodridge raiders have broken into the Clarth hunters' camp on a floating snowy island: red hide tents burning, hunters with fin blades and tooth nets fighting hooded raiders with khopesh and tall shields, smoke rising.

style_description.aesthetics: a lived in war camp seen from a little above, busy with small figures, warm against cold snow
style_description.lighting: warm sunlight from the upper right, short blue shadows falling to the lower left
style_description.art_style: crisp pixel art with clean dark outlines, flat shading in few colours, figures a few pixels tall

compositional_deconstruction.background: a floating island with a flat snowy top and blue ice cliffs, over a white sea of clouds, under a clear blue sky

elements.desc: red hide tents on shark bone frames, several burning with orange flames
Clarth hunters in red cloaks with fin blades and tooth nets, fighting
hooded Bloodridge raiders in sepia rags with khopesh and tall Egyptian shields
dark smoke rising from the burning tents into the sky
